name: Alone
overview: Scripture reveals that being alone is not God's original design, as He declared it was not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper (Genesis 2:18). Yet, even in moments of solitude or affliction, God remains a present help and refuge who hears the cries of the afflicted (Psalms 22:24; 46:1). The omnipresence of God's Spirit assures believers that there is nowhere they can flee from His presence (Psalms 139:7), underscoring that true standing or living alone is only secure when grounded in His presence and the fear of the LORD, which is the beginning of wisdom (Psalms 111:10).
